items.title: SK Hynix (KOSE:A000660) Helps Set An Open Standard For AI Flash Memory
items.summary: SK hynix (KOSE:A000660) and Sandisk have introduced a new High Bandwidth Flash technical specification. The standard has been released through the Open Compute Project and is aimed at AI inference systems. Partners including Google and Tenstorrent are involved in defining the guidelines for this HBF standard. SK hynix is a major memory and storage supplier, with products that sit at the core of data centers and AI hardware. The new HBF specification arrives as AI workloads put more pressure...
